_readme: External certified motor system data for ASTRA-66. This file is the ONLY place motor, retainer and motor-mount numbers are entered.
status PLACEHOLDER: planning values that do not describe any real product; every stability result is flagged as provisional.
status MANUFACTURER_DATA: copy each value from the selected certified product's current published documentation.
designation, manufacturer, certification, data_source, retainer model/data_source, verified_by and date become mandatory.
Never alter, re-work or fabricate a motor. Motor selection, preparation and handling are done by a certified mentor or range officer.
After editing: python cad/build_cad.py --openscad <path>  (re-seats MMT, retainer envelope, lock ring, fin tabs, CG, margin).
_thrust_curve_note: Synthetic test signal, not a real motor. For MANUFACTURER_DATA point this to the certified motor's published RASP (.eng) file placed in simulation/motors/.
